prompt: Find the slope of the line through $(1, 2)$ and $(3, 8)$.
hint: Slope $= \frac{y_2 - y_1}{x_2 - x_1}$ — change in $y$ over change in $x$.

hints.text: Slope $= \frac{y_2 - y_1}{x_2 - x_1}$ — change in $y$ over change in $x$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Walk the stairs
steps: Start at $(1, 2)$. To reach $(3, 8)$ you walk $2$ across and $6$ up.
Per single step across that is $3$ up — slope $3$.
